notes.en: Tier 1 Damage Taken +39.96% on enemies (5 s, from the 2nd use) is not modeled (no vocabulary for enemy debuffs; recording 38 shows it is a separate ×1.3996 multiplier). The Full Burst Time −5 s comes from burst_duration (5 s) in the schedule
